Resolve a slider value against the threshold in effect

Source: R/mod_thresholds.R
resolve_slider_value.Rd

A slider with a fixed step cannot land exactly on a trained threshold such as 0.7224, so a value within half a step of the threshold in effect is taken to mean that threshold.

Usage

resolve_slider_value(value, effective, step)

Arguments

value

Slider value, or NULL before the slider exists.

effective

The threshold currently in effect for the class.

step

Slider step.

Value

effective when value is within half a step of it, otherwise value.
